$comment: Provenance for every edge drawn in assets/profile/system-map-*.svg.
A relationship appears in the public diagram only if it is recorded here
with evidence. An edge that is merely plausible, convenient, or visually
balanced does not belong in this file and therefore cannot appear in the
graphic. Adding an edge means adding evidence, not the other way round.
All paths are relative to public repositories. This file is published on
purpose: it is the audit trail that makes the diagram checkable. A test
(scripts/test_profile_assets.py) fails if a private-looking path, host, or
Private repository names are never recorded in this file.

edges.relation: workforce configuration sits above the execution substrate

evidence.quote: AgentOS is the provider-neutral execution and orchestration substrate. GrokBot Office supplies the workforce configuration that sits above it. The relationship is explicit and read-only at this package boundary; neither project claims ownership of the other.
